_doc: The repository profile of the tool-loop drafter (worker/drafter.py): what is specific to the repository it reviews. project: how the system message names the code under review. rules_card: the file (in this folder) with the rules every request starts from. bot_logins: a regular expression of the logins whose conversation comments hold no review point. group_logins: login patterns shown under one name. skip_rx: the texts that hold no review point of their own, by why (a regular expression each, matched against an item's first comment): such items get no prior row. data_paths and data_suffixes: changed files listed as data in the PR map (a data suffix counts once its change reaches data_min_lines). checks_note: the Our checks point that names what the checks job covers. tracker_keys: the tracker's keys a header tag may carry (KEY-NNNN), found in the PR's own title, body or commits; the configuration's tracker_keys and jira.project are added to them.
